items.computation: The order takes effect 'ab sofort' (immediately) as of the letter's date, 15.05.2025; there is no grace period, so the obligation is already in force from the document date.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Verwaltungsgericht against the Ordnungsverfügung
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, Justizzentrum, Gerichtsstraße 5, 44135 Musterstadt, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 15.05.2025, posted by a German authority: under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Mon 19.05.2025. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period (§ 74 VwGO) starts the next day and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the same-numbered day one month later: Thu 19.06.2025. That day is Fronleichnam (public holiday in NRW), so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 57 Abs. 2 VwGO i.V.m. § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 20.06.2025.

warnings: A Zwangsgeld (coercive penalty payment) of €250 is only threatened for future non-compliance (Zuwiderhandlung); it is not currently due and no payment should be made unless a violation is later established and a separate demand is issued.
The letter states 'Ein Widerspruchsverfahren findet nicht statt' — only a direct Klage to the Verwaltungsgericht is available, not a Widerspruch, so do not wait to file an internal objection first.
The one-month deadline to file suit is a court deadline (Fristsache); get advice (e.g. a lawyer or Verbraucherzentrale) well before 20.06.2025 if you intend to contest the order.

The printed IBAN (DE70 4405 0199 0001 0001 00) is well-formed and belongs to Sparkasse Musterstadt, but no payment is actually requested in this letter — treat any later request to pay to this account with the usual caution and verify it independently.
